documentation.content:
## GKE RAM Alert (90%)

Memory limit utilization in namespace (<K8S_NAMESPACE>) on GKE cluster (<CLUSTER_NAME>) has exceeded **90%** for **2 minutes**.

**Actions Required:**
1. Check pod memory usage: `kubectl top pod -n <K8S_NAMESPACE>`
2. Check for OOMKilled pods: `kubectl get pods -n <K8S_NAMESPACE> | grep -i oom`
